encounters.name: The Root-Binder
dialogue_intro: The grove falls silent. Birds, insects, even the wind — gone.
An old woman sits on a throne of woven roots. She does not rise.
"The seal beneath this reach was placed by hands older than mine. But I keep it. And you will not break it."
She snaps her fingers. The earth lurches.
dialogue_outro: The Root-Binder's throne splinters. She regards you with something that might be respect.
"You fight like someone who has already lost everything. That makes you dangerous."
She presses a sliver of green stone into your palm. "The Warden's path opens beyond the ridge. But choose your next step carefully."

encounters.name: Wildwood Stalker
dialogue_intro: A lithe figure drops from the canopy, landing silently on the forest floor. Twin blades catch the dappled light.
"You're loud. The whole Reach can hear you coming."
dialogue_outro: The Stalker vanishes into the undergrowth as quickly as they appeared.
From the shadows: "You're less loud now. Maybe you'll make it after all."
